# Palnadu.dev

> Technology, software engineering, and advanced digital growth studio based in Palnadu, Andhra Pradesh.

Palnadu.dev is a full-service technology studio engineering high-performance websites, custom web applications, mobile applications, and custom software systems. We deliver advanced technical SEO, Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), software testing, quality assurance, and real-time practical software training for regional enterprises, startups, and institutions across Andhra Pradesh and worldwide.

## Core Capabilities & Services
- [Website Development & UI/UX Design](https://www.palnadu.dev/services/website-development): High-performance corporate websites, modern UI/UX design, and institutional portals engineered with Next.js.
- [Web Applications & Full-Stack Development](https://www.palnadu.dev/services/web-development): Scalable SaaS products, commercial portals, dashboards, and custom web applications.
- [Custom Software Engineering](https://www.palnadu.dev/services/custom-software): Tailored software designed around specific business workflows, godown operations, and inventory.
- [Mobile Applications](https://www.palnadu.dev/services/mobile-app-development): Production iOS, Android, and cross-platform mobile apps.
- [Android App Development](https://www.palnadu.dev/services/android-app-development): Native and cross-platform Android mobile applications for regional commerce.
- [iOS App Development](https://www.palnadu.dev/services/ios-app-development): Premium iOS mobile applications built for iPhone and iPad.
- [Advanced Digital Marketing & Content Strategy](https://www.palnadu.dev/services/digital-marketing): Data-driven digital marketing, content strategy, and commercial lead funnels.
- [Technical SEO, AEO & GEO](https://www.palnadu.dev/services/seo-aeo-geo): Technical SEO, Local Google Maps optimization, Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO).
- [Software Testing & Quality Assurance](https://www.palnadu.dev/services/software-testing-qa): Automated regression testing, cross-device responsiveness verification, and manual QA audits.
- [Real-Time Practical Software & Digital Training](https://www.palnadu.dev/services/practical-training): Hands-on practical training in web development, software engineering, UI/UX design, QA testing, and digital marketing.
- [Business Automation](https://www.palnadu.dev/services/business-automation): Elimination of repetitive manual spreadsheets and paper slips through custom cloud workflows.
- [Idea Validation](https://www.palnadu.dev/services/idea-validation): Technical feasibility assessment, customer workflow analysis, and MVP roadmap scoping.
- [MVP Development](https://www.palnadu.dev/services/mvp-development): Rapid 3-to-6-week minimum viable product launches with 100% source code ownership.
- [Technical Consulting](https://www.palnadu.dev/services/technical-consulting): Architecture reviews, technology selection, and system analysis.
